description: Resolve a company name, native ticker, ISIN or exchange-qualified symbol to Bullrun listings before calling exact-ticker research tools. Supports exchange/MIC, country, currency and instrument-type filters. Recognized Yahoo suffixes are checked against compatible stored venues; dots in native share-class tickers are preserved. Returns explicit ambiguous candidates and never picks a listing when alternatives remain. No enrichment or market-data refresh. Read-only.

country.description: Exact stored country name, e.g. Germany or Switzerland.

currency.description: Listing quote currency, e.g. USD, CHF or GBX. GBX and GBP are different quote units.

exchange.description: Stored exchange code or supported MIC, e.g. XETRA/XETR, NASDAQ/XNAS, SW/XSWX. A conflicting prefix is rejected.

includeInactive.description: Include inactive/retired listings. Returned lifecycle/successor fields must be checked.

includeSecondary.description: Include alternative venue listings. ISIN/name matches across venues require an explicit listing choice.

limit.description: Maximum output candidates. A backend scan is capped at 500 candidates per search.

query.description: Company/name phrase, exact native ticker (AAPL, BMW, BRK.B), ISIN, EXCHANGE:TICKER, or Yahoo symbol (BMW.DE, NESN.SW).

quoteType.description: Default stocks, including unclassified equities. ETF/ALL allow other instrument lookup; this does not make stock-only research tools valid for funds.

name: search_stocks
title: Find stock tickers and company listings
